title: Wellbeing Mode
body: Quiet hours, numbers-off, a pace goal that never affects your tier, and a Pause that keeps your streak.

title: Auctions and the Spec Market
body: Platinum creators can auction slots (second price). Approved-but-unused videos are released to the Spec Market after 30 days.

title: Auto-approve with guardrails
body: Rules with a mandatory dry run on the last 50, a 10% human spot-check and a kill switch.

title: Tax Desk
body: Just-in-time W-9, year-to-date totals, a set-aside estimate and a CSV export. Not tax advice.

title: Winner promotion
body: Brands can run a cleared winner as a Spark or partnership ad with the creator's consent. The fee is 1% of ad spend.

title: Tiers go live
body: Bronze to Elite, earned from cleared earnings, approved work and reliability. No drop for 30 days after a dip.

title: Instant cash-out
body: Cash out in minutes for 1.5% (minimum $0.50, maximum $15). The fee is shown before you confirm. Weekly payouts stay free.

title: Daily Drop
body: One drop a day at 16:00 UTC with real spot counts.

title: Rate cards and direct offers
body: Silver creators can publish a rate card. Brands can buy at your ask or counter up to three rounds.

title: View Ledger and one-tap disputes
body: See every view snapshot for a post, the source mix, and the reason any view was excluded. Dispute from the post in one tap.

title: Brief Lint
body: Briefs with unpaid trials, view-minimum bases or burner-account demands can no longer be published.

title: Timecoded feedback
body: Brands can leave notes anchored to the exact second, with a category and a severity. Must-fix notes carry to your next version.

title: First weekly payout run
body: Payouts run every Friday at 18:00 UTC. Every item shows when it clears and why it is waiting.

title: flowd is live
body: Funded bounties, the Money Clock and weekly payouts are open to the first 200 founding creators and three design-partner apps.
